page_title: AUG 2-1 HEI | Augsburg v Heidenheim 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' 2 - 1 A well-taken corner kick finds Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) who heads home. His precise effort nestles in the roof of the net.
90+2' Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Paul Wanner leaves the pitch and is replaced by Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim).
88' Booking. Robert Gumny (Augsburg) receives a caution from the referee.
86' A great solo run by Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Finn Dahmen.
84' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 61:39.
77' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Alexis Claude-Maurice is replaced by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Samuel Essende can be given a rest.
76' 1 - 1 Goal! Marnon Busch tees up Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top of the net. 1:1.
75' The substitution is prepared. Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Frans Kratzig.
75' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Omar Haktab Traore and he is replaced by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
73' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
73' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
70' It will be a substitution. Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Noahkai Banks walks off.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.

64' What a great touch by Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim win a corner kick.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marius Wolf departs the field of play to be replaced by Robert Gumny (Augsburg).
61' Substitution. Arne Maier walks off the pitch and Mert Komur (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
60' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Adrian Beck will be replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Kerber trots off the pitch and is replaced by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
58' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) meets a cross inside the box, but Kevin Muller wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
57' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
56' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Heidenheim can continue in their attacking effort.
56' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
49' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Referee Florian Badstubner blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' It's in the back of the net! Samuel Essende slips the ball through to Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
45+1' Augsburg get a corner.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Muller shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Augsburg will take a corner kick.
42' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
39' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
38' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar.
34' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar.
33' Heidenheim continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
32' Florian Badstubner blows for a foul after Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Heidenheim earn a free kick.
29' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Kevin Muller.
26' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
20' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Arne Maier (Augsburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
19' Arne Maier (Augsburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Augsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
19' Rough tackle by Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Finn Dahmen displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
13' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Arne Maier (Augsburg) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
10' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

8' Augsburg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
5' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Florian Badstubner.
